question: The word 'direct free kick' is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Football__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A free kick is a method of restarting play in association football.
 
• It is awarded after an infringement of the laws by the opposing team. 
 
• These are given regularly in a game as the offenses committed are very common throughout a full match. This is different from the indirect free kick. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some important terms related to sports are listed here-
 
 
• Football: Corner kick, direct free kick, indirect free kick, dribble, goal kick, penalty, hat trick, off side, tripping, etc.
 
• Volleyboll: Blocking, Doubling, heave, holding, love service, volley
 
• Basketball: Ball, basket, blocking, dribbling, free throw, held ball, holding, jump ball, multiple throws, pivot, etc.
 
• Hockey: Bully, carry, corner, dribble, hat trick, off-side, scoop, short corner, long corner, penalty stroke, etc.
 
• Cricket: Power-play, boundary, bowling, wicket, l.b.w, leg-bye, maiden over, no ball, off break, out, over, pitch, run out, sixer, straight drive, stumped, yorker, etc.
 
• Tennis: Ace, Backhand, Stroke, deuce, deep volley, double fault, fault, ground stroke, half volley, let, lov, slice, smash, volley, etc.
 
• Table tennis: Anti loop, Backspin, chop, loop, penhold grip, twiddle, etc.
